_: Phase 36 Theme H. The ONE budget source: read by scripts/perf/bundle-report.mjs --assert and by every spec under packages/app/e2e/perf/. Rebaselining procedure is in ./README.md — do not edit a number here without the run that justifies it.
_sizes: Deterministic, so the headroom is tight (1.13x the post-phase measurement). The 2.5x rule the phase set is a FLAKE allowance and a byte count does not flake; at 2.5x the entry budget would be 2712 KB, which is above the 2481 KB this phase started from — a budget that permits undoing the phase is not a budget.
_timings: Median of 5 cold packaged-equivalent runs x 2.5, per the phase's stated rule. Medians never maxima, asserted in-spec, and the suite lives outside the default gate.
_scroll: Median frame gap over a 60-frame rAF-driven scroll of a 4000-line diff, x 2.5. Inherited as a literal 100 from diff-scroll-perf.spec.ts, which was an order-of-magnitude tripwire rather than a budget; the measurement is 8.5 ms, so the rule gives 22.
_retention: Phase 45 Theme A. UNLIKE every other budget above, this is a SLOPE (bytes retained PER CYCLE), not a ceiling on a level — the 1.15x/2.5x multiplier rule does NOT apply to it. Set from observed RSS noise on the phase author's machine across repo-cycle and browser-tabs-cycle runs (both expected flat): main/renderer swung up to ~250 KB/cycle from GC and allocator churn alone with only 10-20 samples. 500 KB/cycle sits above that noise floor while still catching Theme C's multi-MB-per-session leak over a real run. Provisional pending more history — see the phase doc's own open question about CI inclusion.
